scope.title: 估商
scope.goal: Determine P1-06's source-backed capability boundary and whether a word-problem modeling transfer is justified before any implementation.
excluded: P1-07 商的位值 implementation or authority changes
P1-08 二位數除數 implementation or authority changes
P1-12 inverse equal-groups transfer or public cutover

currentMatrixAuthority.patternExpansionDescription: 以除數量級與前位關係估商、試商；不宣告新的 canonical KP。

primarySourceSupports: 2位數除以2位數時，除數先用整十估算
3位數除以2位數第一型：十位夠除
3位數除以2位數第二型：十位不夠除
sourceBackedCapabilityFinding.interpretation: P1-06 teaches how to estimate a two-digit divisor and use that estimate while executing division. The difficulty is an arithmetic/representation strategy layered on the two canonical quotient-start cases, not a quantity-relation modeling family.

reasoning: The canonical G4A-U04 authority marks these KPs applicationCapability NOT_APPLICABLE.
The Path1 matrix explicitly names estimate_trial_quotient as a descriptive difficulty expansion rather than a relation pattern.

School exams directly assess divisor-to-whole-ten estimation through selection/fill representations and then exact division, providing strong representation evidence without requiring a story relation.

Division story problems found in the same exam corpus require quotative/partitive or remainder interpretation semantics, which are separate relation capabilities and would cross the P1-11/P1-12 boundary.
P1-12 remains the formal Path1 inverse equal-groups relation stage and is intentionally not pulled forward.

liTeacherEvidence.supportedUse: The corpus separates calculation strategy from named application-problem modules, consistent with the project capability inventory's computation/modeling separation.

candidateMeaning: Select the most appropriate whole-ten approximation for the divisor.
Fill the whole-ten approximation for the divisor.
Use an explicit estimate-first scaffold before exact 3-digit by 2-digit division in the tens-sufficient canonical case.
Use an explicit estimate-first scaffold before exact 3-digit by 2-digit division in the tens-insufficient canonical case.

roundingEvidenceBoundary.canonicalArithmeticDomainStillRemains: 10..99 for the existing two primary KPs; this representation witness restriction does not narrow canonical arithmetic authority

requiredChecks: knowledgePointId is one of the two matrix-primary G4A-U04 P1-06 KPs
quotient and remainder reconstruct dividend and remainder is less than divisor
tens_sufficient item has firstTwoDigits >= divisor and quotient starts at tens place
tens_insufficient item has firstTwoDigits < divisor and quotient starts at ones place
estimate-choice/fill representations only use source-backed unambiguous divisor endings unless a later authority explicitly resolves the 5-tie convention
no application relation, unknown-role modeling, unit conversion, remainder context interpretation, or quotient-place teaching is introduced
no new canonical KP is minted

boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-07: Owns 商的位值 as the next explicit learning target; P1-06 must not turn '商是幾位數' into a new P1-06 Pattern family.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-08: Owns broader 二位數除數 practice and includes the optional 2-digit-by-2-digit ten-multiple support KP; P1-06 remains estimate/trial strategy over its two primary KPs.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-11: Owns remainder and verification emphasis; P1-06 may compute a canonical remainder but must not teach context-dependent remainder interpretation.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-12: Owns formal multiply/divide inverse relation and unknown-role rotation; no P1-12 relation semantics are pulled forward.

distance.distanceReduced: Resolve that P1-06 is a source-backed estimate/trial-quotient arithmetic strategy rather than a word-problem relation, and lock the shortest implementation boundary without crossing P1-07/P1-11/P1-12.
